claims.text: The initial material is a powder mixture of RHEA constituent elements and Cu particles.
Machine-learning-guided SPS will enable a controlled, large-scale RHEA–Cu reaction.
ML-guided SPS will overcome the positive heat of mixing between Cu and refractory elements.
ML-guided SPS will produce a homogeneous and stable RHEA–Cu composite microstructure suitable for nuclear reactor applications.
Milling conditions, consolidation temperature, pressure, and compositional distribution are processing variables that can be optimized for SPS.
A protective atmosphere can be used during mechanical-alloying and SPS manufacture of an RHEA.
High-temperature sintering under an inert or protective atmosphere simulates nuclear reactor service conditions.
Enhanced RHEA–Cu interfacial bonding and controlled phase formation suppress segregation and unstable secondary phases.
A machine-learning framework can analyze the SPS process-parameter space and predict reaction kinetics and diffusion rates.
Controlling reaction kinetics and diffusion during SPS mitigates the effects of positive Cu–refractory heat of mixing.
Controlling reaction kinetics and diffusion during SPS promotes a uniform RHEA–Cu composite microstructure.
The resulting composite will have a robust RHEA matrix interwoven with a well-distributed Cu phase.
The resulting RHEA–Cu composite is expected to maintain high mechanical strength, irradiation resistance, and thermal stability.
Standard SPS without ML optimization tends to produce inhomogeneous RHEA–Cu microstructures and phase segregation.
The baseline inhomogeneity is caused by uncontrolled mixing kinetics in the presence of positive heat of mixing.
Insufficient coverage of relevant processing conditions in the ML training data may limit success.
Scale-up may introduce thermal or contamination problems.
The optimal processing window and industrial scalability remain uncertain pending experimental validation.

contradictions.description: The hypothesis states that the framework will enable a large-scale reaction, while the uncertainty field says industrial scalability remains unknown pending validation.
